basic info

​Sodium: Replaces Minecraft’s old engine with a new one that renders blocks much faster.

​Lithium: Cleans up the "math" behind the game (physics/mobs) so it doesn't lag.

Mod Menu: Just adds a button to the settings so you can actually see this list in-game which i remind you is alot more than this but i can't do that much listen i did this on my own so yeah and i Don't want to tell you about all the mods specially the dependances.
